desc:
BROWNIE MIX: Bake a delicious dessert with this gluten free brownie mix that makes mouthwatering treats

QUICK AND EASY: Make brownies by just adding a few ingredients to baking mix as directed and popping in the oven

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Add your own twist to these mixes or try tested and trusted Betty Crocker recipes

RICH CHOCOLATE BROWNIE: Enjoy rich chocolate flavor of this Betty Crocker Brownie Mix; Serve chocolatey baked goods for sweet celebrations and everyday moments

CONTAINS: 16 oz
features:
Features:

Rich Chocolate Flavor: Made with quality cocoa for a deep, fudgy taste that brownie lovers crave.

Quick & Easy Preparation: Just add water, oil, and eggs — stir and bake, no mixer needed.

Moist & Fudgy Texture: Bakes into soft, chewy brownies with a gooey center and slightly crisp edges.

Customizable Base: Perfect for adding chocolate chips, nuts, caramel, peanut butter, or marshmallows.

Reliable Results: Consistent flavor and texture every time, whether you're baking a full pan or individual portions.

Box Tops for Education: Supports school fundraising programs with every purchase.

Benefits:

Convenience: Saves time in the kitchen without sacrificing homemade taste — ideal for busy schedules or last-minute desserts.

Crowd-Pleaser: Loved by kids and adults alike — a dependable go-to for bake sales, parties, and holidays.

Beginner-Friendly: No baking experience needed; simple steps make it great for all skill levels.

Great Taste Every Time: Delivers rich chocolate flavor and dense, fudgy texture that rivals from-scratch brownies

Family Favorite: A nostalgic treat with the classic Betty Crocker touch — perfect for sharing.

Flexible Servings: Can be made in various pan sizes or turned into brownie cupcakes or layered bars.
ingredients: Sugar, Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Rice Flour, Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Potato Starch, Corn Starch, Canola Oil, Salt, Xanthan Gum.
